item.title: Joni Mitchell’s former Malibu home is listed for $27 million; its beachfront pool may be impossible to recreate today
item.description: Joni Mitchell's former Malibu Colony home is listed for twenty-seven million dollars. This oceanfront property features a rare beachfront swimming pool and spa. The residence offers five bedrooms and five bathrooms with direct beach access. Its Cape Cod-inspired architecture maximizes natural light and ocean views. The home highlights Malibu's evolving luxury housing market and coastal regulations.

item.title: Paris knife attack: Man arrested after three women stabbed near Porte de Clichy
item.description: A man was arrested after stabbing three women near Paris's Porte de Clichy on Monday. One victim, believed to be pregnant, is in critical condition after the attack. The 31-year-old suspect, who reportedly has mental health issues, was apprehended at the scene. Police found two knives in the possession of the arrested individual. An investigation into the incident has been officially opened by authorities.

item.title: 120,000 tourists visited Antarctica in 2025–26; former guides say tourism crossed a line
item.description: A new study has found that some Antarctic tour guides left their dream jobs because they struggled to balance their love for the continent with the environmental impact of growing tourism. After interviewing 25 former guides, researchers found many were deeply affected by witnessing climate change, rising visitor numbers and wildlife disturbance, leading them to leave the industry despite their strong connection to Antarctica.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: This California river once carried thousands of salmon every year. A 1942 dam changed it forever, and scientists are still trying to bring them back
item.description: Friant Dam construction in 1942 altered the San Joaquin River, impacting salmon populations. A 2006 settlement agreement initiated restoration efforts for the river and its fish. The program aims to reestablish spring-run Chinook salmon while managing water for agriculture. Multiple agencies collaborate on scientific research and habitat improvements for the river. Monitoring tracks progress and guides adjustments for long-term ecological recovery.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: They bought this Laguna Beach home for $16 million and spent $20 million rebuilding it. It is now listed for $112 million
item.description: A Laguna Beach oceanfront estate is now on the market for $112 million. The owners invested $20 million to extensively renovate the property over two years. This remarkable residence spans 14,400 square feet and includes six bedrooms. The owners are selling as they have relocated and no longer need the large home. This listing aims to set a new residential sales record for Orange County.

item.title: Syngenta will stop selling paraquat in Australia after strict new safety rules, but generic versions of the controversial herbicide will remain available
item.description: Syngenta is ceasing paraquat sales in Australia after new safety regulations were introduced. This decision impacts product choice and market stability for Australian farmers. Generic paraquat will remain available, but Syngenta's exit raises supply concerns. New rules aim to reduce exposure risks for workers and the environment. Growers must now adapt to stricter conditions and potential market shifts.

item.title: Logan Paul releases new limited-edition PRIME bottle honoring Oliver Tree's legacy
item.description: Logan Paul has launched a limited-edition version of PRIME inspired by Oliver Tree, with every dollar earned going to the late musician's foundation. The initiative honors the late singer and supports grants for young artists. It also carries forward Tree's vision of helping creators bring their ideas to life through hands-on artistic projects.

item.title: Indian-origin doctor's viral bindi video sparked an online backlash that she had never seen in her life: 5 other times Indians faced similar rhetoric in recent years
item.description: An Indian-origin plastic surgeon in the US says a light-hearted video about her bindi triggered an unprecedented wave of anti-Indian abuse online. Her experience reflects a wider trend identified by recent research, with many Indian Americans reporting racist slurs, online harassment and discrimination. Studies warn that hostility towards visible Hindu and Indian identity is increasing, both online and offline.

item.title: Hamptons Mansion Auction Set: Libbie Mugrabi estate faces $11m court sale; experts warn on equity hit
item.description: Socialite Libbie Mugrabi's luxury Bridgehampton mansion is set to be sold in a rare court-ordered public auction after repeated attempts to sell the property privately failed. The auction follows a legal dispute over an unpaid $3.5 million loan secured against the estate. The property, originally listed for $25 million and later reduced to $19 million, will open for bidding at $11 million on August 28.

item.title: World's narrowest island capital just 150 metres wide could disappear beneath rising seas, World Bank warns
item.description: Majuro, capital of the Republic of Marshall Islands, confronts severe threats from rising sea levels. Coastal erosion accelerates due to increased wind speeds and human interference. Adaptation measures like sea walls and land raising are being considered by policymakers. However, migration may become a last resort for the Marshallese people.
